comment: Exact, finite list of the sections whose markdown table legitimately carries yes/no in its FIRST column, per document kind. Detection matches the section heading LITERALLY. The mutating helpers (plan-reconcile-lib.sh, plan-document-lib.sh) preserve and rewrite the row of the entry whose role is 'testing-requirement' by scanning that section only. No helper emits a yes/no table anywhere else, so one under any other heading arrived by hand: validate-plan FAILS on it (validate-plan-goals-lib.sh), like the other hand-edit-damage gates, and the remedy is to rebuild the section through update-plan-content.sh. Register a new section here when a template starts emitting one; there is exactly one testing-requirement entry per document kind.
